QUOTE: "`edge_class` | Distinguishes a call from other causal edges. `callers` is documented as "callers plus the writers it reads from", so a writer can appear in the list." and "**Mixed edge kinds.** A writer that shares a key with the subject is in the same list as a true caller. Filter on `edge_class` before counting."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that callers mixes true calls with shared-key writers in one list and that the consumer must filter on `edge_class`.
